expected.world_generates_on: next server start, not during activation

notes: hasArchivedZip is false and willGenerateFresh is true here (freshLevelName non-empty, line 667), so activateSlot skips the unzip branch entirely and instead calls applyWorldIdentity(applySeed: true) at line 761 -- but the current-folder removal at lines 685-702 is unconditional, running for every activation regardless of which branch follows. So switching to a fresh slot does delete the previous live world (backed up first, per the mandatory-backup fixture) even though nothing is extracted to replace it; the new world only exists once the server process itself generates it on next boot.
